history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this CSV row (seq 2370, 'Shri Trivati Nath Temple') is the same temple as seq 1097 (id trivati-nath-temple-bareilly). One of the four Nath temples of Nath Nagari, Bareilly, on Trivati Nath Marg (Nainital Road side) near Jawahar Nagar/Gandhi Nagar. It houses shivlings and statues of Maa Bhagvati and her nine forms; popular belief holds that devoted worship fulfils wishes. LOCATION-DESCRIPTION CONFLICT: one source places it in the central part of the city, another on the outskirts (flagged). Published timings cover only the morning (5:00 AM-1:00 PM); afternoon/evening hours are unverified.

town_description: Bareilly is a major city in western Uttar Pradesh on the northern Gangetic plain, traditionally called Nath Nagari for its cluster of ancient Shiva temples. A historic trade and cantonment town, it is known for zardozi embroidery, furniture and the Ala Hazrat dargah alongside its Hindu shrines, and is well connected by rail and road to Delhi and Lucknow.

travel.road: On the Nainital Road side of the city; taxis, autos and local buses available.

visitor_information.best_time: November to April; Maha Shivaratri is the main festival.
